attributes.name: hands_above_head
attributes.text: The hands are active above the head.
attributes.definition: During the main phase at least one hand is higher than the head joint.

attributes.name: hands_at_head_level
attributes.text: The hands are active at the level of the face and head.
attributes.definition: During the main phase at least one hand is between chin and crown height, close to the head.

attributes.name: hands_at_chest_front
attributes.text: The hands are active in front of the chest.
attributes.definition: During the main phase the hands are in front of the torso between the shoulders and the lower ribs, with elbows bent.

attributes.name: hands_at_waist_front
attributes.text: The hands are active low in front of the waist.
attributes.definition: During the main phase the hands are in front of the body at about hip or waist height, below the chest.

attributes.name: hands_near_floor
attributes.text: The hands reach down near the floor.
attributes.definition: During the main phase at least one hand is lower than the knees, close to the feet or floor.

attributes.name: hands_behind_body
attributes.text: The hands move behind the back or shoulders.
attributes.definition: At least one hand passes behind the plane of the torso during the main phase.

attributes.name: hand_at_hip_side
attributes.text: A hand is active at the side of the hip.
attributes.definition: During the main phase a hand is next to the outside of the hip or upper thigh, not in front of the body.

attributes.name: hand_far_in_front
attributes.text: A hand is far out in front of the body.
attributes.definition: During the main phase a hand is at nearly full arm's length forward of the shoulder.

attributes.name: hands_out_to_sides
attributes.text: The hands are held out to the sides of the body.
attributes.definition: During the main phase the hands are lateral to the shoulders, away from the body midline.

attributes.name: hand_crosses_midline
attributes.text: A hand moves across to the opposite side of the body.
attributes.definition: At least one hand ends clearly on the other side of the body midline from its own shoulder.

attributes.name: arms_hang_at_sides
attributes.text: The arms hang at the sides throughout.
attributes.definition: The hands stay near the thighs for the whole action, at most swinging loosely with the steps, and never rise toward the chest or head.
